description: mailbox.rs handle_mailbox_query (lines 188-206): filter keys are first validated against KNOWN_FILTER_KEYS with a linear scan (args.get then iterate), then the entire filter value is removed and re-parsed via serde_json::from_value into MailboxFilterCondition. This means the filter JSON is visited twice — once to check key names, once to deserialize — and the first pass is redundant: serde_json would already reject unknown fields if MailboxFilterCondition had #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)], which is the idiomatic approach. The two-pass pattern also means the validation and parsing diverge if KNOWN_FILTER_KEYS is not kept in sync with the struct fields. Suggested rewrite: add #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)] to MailboxFilterCondition and remove the manual KNOWN_FILTER_KEYS scan; a serde error maps to unsupportedFilter via the existing map_err.
title: mailbox.rs: KNOWN_FILTER_KEYS validated then re-parsed from args.remove
